profile.headline: Sr Cloud Software Engineer at CrowdStrike
profile.summary:
Have been working with real-time distributed system which enables fast AI processing. 

I like solving problems, improving myself technically and emotionally. I'm also a big fan of Liverpool FC and love reading manga!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and launched a highly available and scalable upstream service that handles scheduling and kicking off realtime media processing for the core orchestration system.
• Responsible for maintaining high software quality and reliability of all microservices on the system and scaling the system to handle ingesting and processing thousands of media streams per day. Improved Kafka server to be highly reliable and fault-tolerant for the massive production volume. This feature is seen as most important in the company’s direction in 2018, drastically improved latency and customer experience and marking our real-time processing feature production-ready. 
• Often the point of contact for Kafka for the team - the critical link between different system components. Ensured kafka’s robust performance for faster realtime machine learning processing.
• Designed and shipped critical features such as rate limiter, GraphQL and Kafka client library that ensures lower latency and high reliability across system components and AI engines. 
• Owned, maintained and developed an API server that enables low latency streaming from mobile device to ingest and process recognition and transcription for customers.
• Together with the team, launched the system on different regions and on premise. (Golang, AWS, Kafka, Redis, Docker, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Grafana, Node.js, TypeScript, back-end development, distributed system)
